name: Mountain Pose (Tadasana)
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang by your sides. Lengthen the back of your neck and keep your chin level.
Breathe in and raise both arms overhead with the palms facing each other. Reach up without lifting your shoulders towards your ears.
Hold for five slow breaths, then lower your arms as you breathe out.

name: Chair Pose (Utkatasana)
steps: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and send your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair. Keep your knees over your ankles.
Reach your arms forward and up beside your ears. Keep your chest lifted and your back long.
Hold for three to five breaths. To come out, press through your feet and stand tall.

name: Standing Forward Fold (Uttanasana)
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Breathe out and fold forward from your hips, not your waist. Bend your knees as much as you need to.
Let your head and arms hang heavy. Your hands can rest on your shins, on blocks or on the floor.
Hold for five breaths. To come up, bend your knees and roll up slowly with your head last.

name: Downward-Facing Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana)
steps: Start on your hands and knees with your hands slightly ahead of your shoulders.
Curl your toes under and lift your knees as you push your hips up and back.
Press your hands into the floor and lengthen your spine. Keep your knees soft and let your heels reach down.
Hold for five breaths, then lower your knees to the floor and rest.

name: Cobra Pose (Bhujangasana)
steps: Lie on your front with your legs together and your hands under your shoulders.
Breathe in, press gently through your hands and lift your chest. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders away from your ears. Look forward.
Hold for three breaths and lower down as you breathe out. Stop if you feel pain in your lower back.

name: Sphinx Pose (Salamba Bhujangasana)
steps: Lie on your front with your legs stretched behind you.
Place your forearms on the floor with your elbows under your shoulders.
Press your forearms down and lift your chest gently. Keep your hips on the floor and your neck long.
Stay for five to eight breaths, then lower down slowly.

name: Child's Pose (Balasana)
steps: Kneel on the floor with your big toes together and your knees apart.
Sit your hips back towards your heels and fold forward.
Rest your forehead on the floor and stretch your arms forward, or lay them by your sides.
Stay for as long as is comfortable, breathing slowly into your back.

name: Warrior I (Virabhadrasana I)
steps: Step one foot back about a leg length behind you. Turn the back foot out slightly and keep it flat.
Bend your front knee over your ankle. Keep your back leg straight.
Square your hips to the front and reach both arms up beside your ears.
Hold for five breaths, then step your feet together and repeat on the other side.

name: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart, about one leg length. Turn your right foot out and your left foot in slightly.
Bend your right knee over your ankle. Keep your left leg straight.
Stretch your arms out to the sides at shoulder height and look over your front hand.
Hold for five breaths, then change sides.

name: Triangle Pose (Trikonasana)
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your right foot out. Keep your legs straight.
Reach your right arm forward and hinge from your hip, keeping your waist long.
Place your right hand on your shin, a block or the floor, and reach your left arm up.
Hold for five breaths, rise with a long spine and change sides.

name: Tree Pose (Vrksasana)
steps: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Place the sole of your other foot on your calf or inner thigh. Do not press it on the knee.
Bring your hands together at your chest, or reach them overhead.
Look at a fixed spot to stay steady. Hold for five breaths and change sides.

name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana)
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms down.
Press into your feet and lift your hips until your body makes a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Hold for three to five breaths and lower down slowly.

name: Seated Forward Bend (Paschimottanasana)
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs stretched in front of you. Sit on a folded blanket if your back rounds.
Breathe in and lengthen your spine. Breathe out and fold forward from your hips.
Hold your shins, ankles or feet. Keep your knees slightly bent if your legs feel tight.
Hold for five breaths and come up with a long back.

name: Boat Pose (Navasana)
steps: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lean back a little and lift your feet so your shins are parallel to the floor.
Stretch your arms forward beside your knees. Keep your chest lifted.
Hold for three to five breaths. To make it easier, keep your knees bent or hold behind your thighs.

name: Locust Pose (Salabhasana)
steps: Lie on your front with your arms by your sides and your forehead on the floor.
Breathe in and lift your chest, arms and legs a little way off the floor.
Look down slightly so your neck stays long. Squeeze your legs together.
Hold for three breaths and lower down. Repeat a few times.

name: Low Lunge (Anjaneyasana)
steps: Start on your hands and knees and step one foot forward between your hands.
Place your back knee on the floor, on a folded blanket if you like. Keep the front knee over your ankle.
Lift your chest and reach your arms up. Let your hips sink forward.
Hold for five breaths and change sides.

name: Easy Pose (Sukhasana)
steps: Sit on the floor, or on a folded blanket, and cross your legs at the shins.
Rest your hands on your knees and sit tall.
Relax your shoulders and keep your chin level.
Breathe slowly for one to three minutes. Switch the cross of your legs halfway through.

name: Corpse Pose (Savasana)
steps: Lie on your back with your legs a little apart and your arms away from your body, palms up.
Close your eyes and let your feet fall outwards.
Let your breath become slow and natural. Relax your face, jaw and shoulders.
Stay for two to five minutes. Roll to one side before you sit up.

name: Garland Pose (Malasana)
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your hips and turn your toes out a little.
Bend your knees and lower into a deep squat. Put a folded blanket under your heels if they lift.
Bring your palms together at your chest and press your elbows gently against your knees.
Hold for five breaths and stand up slowly.

name: Standing Side Bend (Crescent Moon)
steps: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart and reach your arms overhead.
Hold your wrists or join your palms.
Breathe in to lengthen, then breathe out and bend gently to one side without leaning forward.
Hold for three breaths, come back to the middle and bend to the other side.

name: Happy Baby Pose (Ananda Balasana)
steps: Lie on your back and bring your knees towards your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet, or your shins, with your hands.
Open your knees wider than your body and press your feet gently into your hands.
Rock softly from side to side for five breaths and release.
